answer: Seed every challenge from a public randomness beacon so prompts cannot be precomputed or farmed ahead. Picture the beacon as a lantern swung at an unknown moment: before it lights, the task is a nebula of possibilities; after, all identities face the same sharp question inside a tight window. A sybil operator cannot pre-bake answers behind a juniper hedge of stockpiled templates, because the seed only exists at reveal time.
